document_role: Current documentary E2 design draft; no executable training configuration or complete preregistration.

historical_pilot_draft.role: Historical record retained unchanged; not the current operative configuration.

input.shape: N x D x 5, or a view with 5D components without added information
input.availability: For outcome day d, complete OHLCV through d-1 is known at the start of d.

target.scale: original daily log-return standard deviation units
target.available_at: end of outcome day d; not an input at the start of d

missingness.policy: strict exclusion; no imputation; preserve calendar positions
missingness.window_rule: Do not concatenate nonconsecutive observed rows across excluded days.

calendar.split_seed_reason: Chronological deterministic split, no random shuffling.
calendar.embargo_rule: For outer outcome t omit [t-D,t-1]; training outcome u <= t-D-1, with availability and quality checks.

metrics.metric_scale: original target units after any registered inverse target transform
metrics.aggregation: Pool out-of-training predictions by configuration/model/seed, then compute metrics; do not average daily-fold RMSE.
metrics.mape: Positive targets only; disclose coverage and zero exclusions, no arbitrary epsilon.
metrics.mase: Lag1 calendar day; denominator from permitted training only; undefined if denominator is zero or no valid pairs.
metrics.r2: Evaluation-sample target mean; undefined with constant target or one outcome.

practical_margin.reference: persistence on the same eligible outcome dates
practical_margin.role: Operational practical criterion; not a calibrated financial utility or automatic margin between two networks.

mase_valid_scale_population.common_scale_reference: Same permitted training-target cohort across compared methods at each origin; original target units.
mase_valid_scale_population.eligible_scale_mask: I_M contains evaluation origins with defined, strictly positive training scale.
mase_valid_scale_population.aggregation: Mean of origin-scaled absolute errors over I_M, using N_M=|I_M|; not global MAE divided by a later chosen scale.
mase_valid_scale_population.empty_population: Undefined MASE when N_M=0; prediction failures follow the incident policy, not silent mask exclusion.

selection_and_implementation.source_correction: S1 winning LSTM/GRU/TCN hyperparameters exist in Appendix C Tables5-6; they are source-task settings, not frozen project implementations.
configuration_fields_required_per_model: scheduler and settings or explicit none
weight decay and other regularization or explicit none
selection_and_implementation.unknown_source_architecture_rule: Do not fill missing architecture details by preference; declare and justify the E2 architecture-search space before training.

inner_split_constraints: Inner early-stopping targets are past and observable before the outer forecast origin.
Inner training and early-stopping validation have a recorded chronological separation and maximum-lag embargo.
Preprocessing is fitted to the inner training subset, not to the early-stopping subset.
The outer forecast target is not used to select epochs or checkpoints.
For outer outcome t, inner validation ends no later than t-D-1. With first inner validation outcome v, fit outcomes u <= v-D-1; preserve quality/availability checks.
training_and_search_pending.initialization_rule: Each independent repetition starts from new weights; any within-repetition incremental rule must be registered and causal.
training_and_search_pending.fairness: Same method and evaluation budget with justified architecture-specific spaces; same information, samples and validation criterion.

pilot_and_repetitions_pending.principle: Seed variation is conditional on the observed temporal protocol; folds/configurations/seeds do not create independent markets.

detect_a_difference_from_zero.question: Detect a predeclared accuracy difference versus a zero-difference null boundary.
detect_a_difference_from_zero.limitation: Detecting an effect of the planning size against zero does not establish that the gain exceeds that size.

demonstrate_more_than_five_percent_vs_pe.relative_gain_definition: 1 - RMSE_model / RMSE_persistence on the same eligible dates and the predeclared seed-aggregation rule.
demonstrate_more_than_five_percent_vs_pe.effect_distance_for_power: q_alt - 0.05 in relative-gain units, with q_alt > 0.05 under the registered statistic and seed aggregation.
demonstrate_more_than_five_percent_vs_pe.undefined_baseline_case: If persistence RMSE is zero, the relative gain is undefined; retain and report the case under a registered rule.
demonstrate_more_than_five_percent_vs_pe.absolute_effect_distance_for_power: g_alt - 0.05 * baseline_rmse_development_for_planning, if the absolute formulation is used with matching units.

shared_pending.rule: Select the claim and its null boundary before choosing the planning effect, estimating variability or computing R/MDE.

required_per_run_artifacts: run identifier, phase, model slot, configuration, seed and attempt parent
fitted preprocessing parameters with fit-sample identifiers
epoch logs of training and inner-validation loss/metrics
best/stopped epochs and checkpoint restoration record
trainable/nontrainable parameter counts and analytic comparison
dated predictions, observed targets, horizon and coverage
training/inference timing, warmup, batch size and GPU synchronization if relevant
CPU/GPU/RAM, device/runtime, precision and determinism settings
failures, warnings, retries and excluded/missing predictions
reproducibility_pending.retry_rule: Keep original failed attempts and causes; no replacement of unfavorable seeds; technical retries retain a link to the original attempt.

unit_identifiers.run: model, configuration, phase, repetition, protocol version; full sequence of forecasts
unit_identifiers.fit: run plus origin, inner split, checkpoint and attempt; fits are not independent seed runs

test_protocol_pending.evaluation_rule: One frozen chronological evaluation pass per run; each prediction precedes its outcome. Saved predictions support reporting without adaptive design reselection.
test_protocol_pending.updates_if_registered: Only already-observed information, permitted training outcomes and the frozen causal update schedule; no automatic daily/static policy.

execution_state.existing_eda_ridge_role: Separate block-C diagnostic; no effect on final DL family or update-policy selection.

before_pilot_close: Select and substantiate exactly three DL architectures under the guide criteria.
Register complete implementation/search specifications and a compatible training environment.
Register inner temporal validation, preprocessing, stopping and within-run update rules.
Fix common pilot scope/seeds, comparison quantities/margins and the inference/multiplicity design.
Freeze the dated initial pilot protocol while retaining this documentary draft and the historical draft.
after_pilot_before_definitive_execution: Preserve all real run records, report variability and paired differences under the declared estimand.
Dimension repetitions and report MDE with assumptions/limitations; do not equate five seeds with adequate power.
Freeze the definitive protocol, sample manifests, test and reporting rules before evaluating test.
nonexecutable_reason: Required architecture, training environment, seeds and evaluation settings remain unset.
